title: The Borrowed Will
author: Lena Blackwood
blurb: Sebastian Quintana, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
